difficulty.reason: Internal integrations take minutes; public OAuth requires zero manual Notion review before going live.

timeEstimate.notes: Notion allows public distribution as soon as company information and valid URLs are provided.

requirements: Published Privacy Policy and Terms of Service URLs (for public OAuth)

steps.title: Create an Integration in Notion Developers
steps.description: Go to notion.so/profile/integrations and click 'New integration'. Assign an app name and choose an associated workspace.

steps.title: Select Integration Type & Capabilities
steps.description: Choose 'Internal integration' for your own workspace, or toggle to 'Public integration' to allow any Notion user to connect. Select capabilities (Read, Update, Insert content).

steps.title: Configure OAuth Redirect URI and Company Info
steps.description: In the 'Distribution' tab, input your HTTPS redirect URI, your company name, and links to your privacy policy and terms.

steps.title: Retrieve OAuth Credentials
steps.description: Copy your OAuth Client ID and Client Secret from the 'Secrets' tab. Store them in `.env.local`.

blockers.problem: Agent receives 404 or empty results when querying pages or databases
blockers.solution: Notion uses granular page-level permissions. The user must explicitly grant the integration access to pages using the 'Add connections' menu inside Notion page settings.
Notion verifies that privacy policy and terms URLs are reachable HTTPS links. Ensure both endpoints return HTTP 200.

agentCanDo: Construct the Notion authorization URL with proper `client_id`, `redirect_uri`, and `response_type=code`
Handle the OAuth callback and exchange authorization code with `https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/token`
Parse and securely persist workspace ID, bot ID, and access tokens
developerMustDo: Create the integration in the Notion Developer portal
Upload your application logo and brand details
Publish valid Privacy Policy and Terms of Service web pages

managedOption.managedSufficientWhen: Composio's managed Notion integration is ideal for 95% of use cases because Notion users always select which pages to share during the consent screen, regardless of whether the app is managed or custom.
managedOption.customRequiredWhen: A custom Notion integration is only required if you want your company's custom logo and brand name shown at the top of the Notion workspace connection selector.

claims.claim: Notion does not require manual review or approval before public OAuth can be used in production.
Users must explicitly grant page-level permissions to the integration during or after OAuth authorization.

openQuestions: Will Notion introduce an app review process for integrations requesting workspace-wide search permissions in the future?
